items.question_text: An 84-year-old woman with metastatic lung cancer dies at home after a week of progressive breathlessness. She has not seen a doctor in the last three months. What is the most appropriate action?  You never treated her. Old age and cardiac arrest are not causes here. Convenience of the funeral is irrelevant. Refer.  The duty is yours on the facts given. A family wish or a faster funeral does not change it.  Report or refuse as the rule requires. Do not invent a cause or a clearance.  Nothing else in the file creates an exception. Apply the reporting or disclosure rule as it stands.  A colleague's suggestion to certify, sign, or release does not override that rule.  Decide on the facts given and the duty they create. Do that. Now. Clearly. Today.
